title: Update a lowercase content-length and close the replaced body

files.patch:
@@ -19,7 +19,8 @@ def insert(status, headers, body)
       script_tag += "></script>"
       modified_content = content.sub("</head>", "#{script_tag}\n</head>")
 
-      headers["Content-Length"] = modified_content.bytesize.to_s if headers["Content-Length"]
+      length_header = headers.keys.find { it.to_s.casecmp?("content-length") }
+      headers[length_header] = modified_content.bytesize.to_s if length_header
 
       [status, headers, [modified_content]]
     end
@@ -32,12 +33,16 @@ def html_response?(headers)
       content_type&.include?("text/html")
     end
 
+    # The original body is replaced, so it's closed here as the Rack spec asks:
+    # that releases a file body and runs Rack::BodyProxy callbacks.
     def extract(body)
       if body.respond_to?(:each)
         [].tap { |parts| body.each { |part| parts << part } }.join
       else
         body.to_s
       end
+    ensure
+      body.close if body.respond_to?(:close)
     end
   end
 end

@@ -1,4 +1,5 @@
 require_relative "test_helper"
+require "rack/body_proxy"
 
 class TestAgent < Minitest::Test
   include Rack::Test::Methods
@@ -63,6 +64,26 @@ def test_updates_content_length_header
     assert headers["Content-Length"].to_i > 39
   end
 
+  def test_updates_lowercase_content_length_header
+    html = "<html><head></head><body></body></html>"
+
+    _, headers, body = @agent.insert(200, {"content-type" => "text/html", "content-length" => "39"}, [html])
+
+    assert_equal body.first.bytesize.to_s, headers["content-length"]
+    refute headers.key?("Content-Length")
+  end
+
+  def test_closes_the_original_body
+    closed = []
+    html = Rack::BodyProxy.new(["<html><head></head><body></body></html>"]) { closed << :html }
+    json = Rack::BodyProxy.new(['{"data": "value"}']) { closed << :json }
+
+    @agent.insert(200, {"content-type" => "text/html"}, html)
+    @agent.insert(200, {"content-type" => "application/json"}, json)
+
+    assert_equal [:html], closed
+  end
+
   def test_handles_chunked_body
     html = ["<html><head>", "</head><body></body></html>"]
     _, _, body = @agent.insert(200, {"Content-Type" => "text/html"}, html)
